name: Ana Maria Arango Eusse
title: Release & Delivery Manager
tagline: 6+ years leading enterprise-scale software releases in cloud environments, with a strong focus on healthcare platforms.
summary: Certified Scrum Master fluent in English, Spanish, and French, experienced in orchestrating UAT-to-Production deployments, governing change through CABs, and driving Go/No-Go decisions. Proven track record scaling deployment throughput, reducing operational overhead, and aligning technical execution with business outcomes through Agile delivery and strong stakeholder leadership.

highlights: Led Release & Deployment Operations, orchestrating end-to-end release lifecycles from UAT to Production in cloud environments for major enterprise healthcare clients.
Scaled deployment frequency by 50% (194+ major events in 2025), coordinating 277 customer deployments and 147 hotfixes while reducing deployment hours by 30% year-over-year.
Reduced technical support hours by 69% by optimizing workflows and centralizing release ownership, enabling teams to focus on upstream quality.
Implemented strategic separation of Release and Deployment processes, designing scalable workflows for "Team Releases" and "Customer Deployments" with distinct QA approvals.
Co-created Deployment Request Board and established Change Advisory Board (CAB) to govern deployment windows and prevent collisions between planned changes.
Launched Deployment Tracker Dashboard, providing real-time visibility into 365 days of history for 5,862+ customer changes.
Led release readiness sessions and Go/No-Go decisions, developing runbooks and compatibility matrices to identify and mitigate implementation risks.
Accelerated delivery by 15% through Agile planning and Scrum facilitation.
Reduced issues by 25% by proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
Enhanced efficiency by 10% using prioritization frameworks and structured Jira release versions.
Partnered with Product Owners to define commitments, estimations, and roadmaps.
Ensured project success through clear communication and strict timeline adherence.
Led a global team of 16, reducing delivery time by 15% and completing 10+ projects on time.
Increased project delivery speed by 15% and reduced costs by 20% through Agile coaching and process optimization.
Launched B2B product increasing user engagement by 20%.
Delivered 7+ backend products using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Led SEO initiatives to achieve corporate OKRs and align roadmap objectives.
Managed end-to-end project delivery across product and communications initiatives.
Coordinated cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to meet project milestones.
Produced audiovisual content and managed communications projects.
